headline: Head Athletic Trainer
body:
Miami FC
Miami, Florida

Read the employer’s requirements before applying.
caption:
Opportunity watch: Miami FC is advertising a Head Athletic Trainer role in Miami, Florida.

Qualifications excerpt: Certified Athletic Trainer (BOC Certified) in good standing. Eligible for and maintains appropriate state licensure/certification. Current CPR, AED, and First Aid certification. Experience working in collegiate, professional, or elite-level sports preferred. Strong knowledge of injury prevention, evaluation, rehabilitation, emergency care, and return-to-play protocols. Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills. Ability to travel extensively and work evenings, weekends, holidays, and all match days.

Confirm the full eligibility, compensation and current availability with the employer. Source checked 2026-10-06; availability can change.

Official listing: https://www.teamworkonline.com/soccer-jobs/usl-soccer-jobs/miami-fc-jobs/head-athletic-trainer-2192952

headline: Ticketing Intern
body:
Miami FC
Miami, Florida

Read the employer’s requirements before applying.
caption:
Opportunity watch: Miami FC is advertising a Ticketing Intern role in Miami, Florida.

Qualifications excerpt: Currently enrolled in a college or university pursuing a degree in Sports Management, Marketing, Business, Communications, Sales, or a related field. Strong communication and organizational skills. Interest in professional sports, ticket sales, marketing, and fan engagement. Positive attitude and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable communicating with fans, community members, and potential customers. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Previous customer service, sales, or marketing experience is a plus but not required. Spanish is a plus.

Confirm the full eligibility, compensation and current availability with the employer. Source checked 2026-10-06; availability can change.
